## Axial alignment

**Glossary / Sampling and measurements** · **Construct**

[result struct containing numeric scores/angles and logical validity]

Comparison of directions with 0–pi symmetry: reversing either direction leaves the alignment score unchanged.

<details>
<summary>Input layout and MATLAB lookup</summary>


